order: Alternate legacy/candidate then candidate/legacy within pairs; one audit at a time; one shared 4x2 backend

latency_gate.metric: Median end-to-end seconds across the 8 supported-case runs per mode
latency_gate.cache_policy: No audit-result cache; every run invokes actual provider and retrieval as required by its path.

quality_gates: Zero model, transport or structural failures in paired runs
Exact SEC source, citation metadata and quote grounding on every paired result
All available planned subqueries cited; unavailable scopes publish no claims; mixed side preserved
Full frozen 30-case candidate run independently verified, no available-topic gaps, all expected absent scopes withheld
No changes to corpus, model, sparse/vector/reranking artifacts
Fallback is bounded to one real existing synthesis call; no fake model ledger entries
Original and candidate modes remain separately runnable and raw failures preserved
release_rule: Push only if all quality and latency gates pass; do not rerun unchanged to seek a lucky result.
scope_note: Source-informed regression fixtures, not independent semantic gold. Small-sample matched timing observations are not an SLA or p99 benchmark.
